transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I keep holding on to this belief that my clients and managers are secretly monitoring and using my translations in ways they deny, and nothing anyone says can convince me otherwise. My wife urged me to come here to talk about it, but I just can't shake this conviction.

Besides this belief, have you been hearing voices or noticing things others don’t, or have people said your speech or behavior has become confused or disorganized? Have you also had trouble with motivation, emotions, or taking care of yourself?

No, I don't hear any voices, see strange things, or have any issues with my speech or motivation. I am still working full-time, paying my bills, and taking care of my daily responsibilities at home without any trouble. My life is completely normal except for the specific decisions I've had to make because of this monitoring, like turning down a promotion and avoiding certain work trips.
How long have you been convinced that your clients and managers are secretly monitoring and using your translations? Has this belief been present for at least one month?

Yes, it has been going on for much longer than a month—it's been about eleven months now. It all started after a tense video call where they challenged my word choices on a project, and I've held this belief continuously ever since.

During these 11 months, have you had long periods of feeling very depressed or unusually high/energetic, and if so, did those mood changes happen for most of the time that this belief has been present?

No, I haven't really experienced any periods of feeling very depressed or unusually energetic during this time. My mood has remained quite stable, other than the natural stress of dealing with this situation.
